title: No κ gain: close the 29 remaining fixed-paid P104 rank-eight cuts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Close all 29 cuts left unresolved by #7363. Four new exact rational checks and 25 certified reversible public-bank transfers exclude every residual cut. The frozen census is now **326 excluded, zero unresolved**. Three new representatives have zero cut and endpoint pairings; the fourth has zero productive prefix image.

The result holds for one rank-eight 4+4 split in the 15-role chart 3→245 cohort, with the #7334 word, signed #7113 caller, fixed paid itinerary and existing public banks. **Δκ = 0.** The conditional comparator is κ = 0.00364665195644; selected #7000 remains κ = 0.00363005817. No new word or caller is supplied.

## Task and overlap

`p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8; exact continuation of #7363 at `a0502b0b30a4a4a0e9a37c08e83febbd515c5955`. [Scope claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19556783). The new pre-event/chart keys are (45270,242), (45277,242), (45435,242) and (45676,1091). #7367 is the transfer precedent on rank seven; #7370 covers rank five; #7244 and #7274 change the paid itinerary.

## Validation

`python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-eight-residual-closure/replay.py` regenerates 17 predecessor receipts and the residual receipt in about 39 seconds locally. The two exact trace paths agree on the support spaces and pairing decisions. The transfer checker verifies both matrix products and rejects mixed contacts, bank COPY and zero SCALE. Local registered replay, Git-free export and replay, committed bytes, modes, source history and six navigation tests passed.

Canonical base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The branch reuses the two unchanged #7257 CI prerequisites already used by #7363; the new research is one commit. The selected record has no diff.

## Credit and open questions

ToikY's #7363 and #7367 supply the census, trace implementations and transfer method. #7334, #7113, #7298, #7338, #7314 and #7319 supply the source, caller, pricing and census lineage. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the proof, implementation and replay.

Changed paid routes, banks using owned fields, other cohorts and interacting edits remain outside this bound. Price any proposed paid route change before construction: an extra rank-one paid position erases this split's optimistic credit.
